\section{Explicit contradiction}
\subsection{General claim}
For every real input $x$, the score $f(x)$ is nonnegative.
\subsection{Counterexample}
At the real input $x=-1$, the same score satisfies $f(-1)=-2$.

\section{Different conditions, not a contradiction}
\subsection{Bounded regime}
For bounded inputs of norm at most one, the approximation error is at most $0.1$.
\subsection{Unbounded regime}
For an unbounded input of norm ten, the approximation error can equal $1$.

\section{Similar names, not confirmed synonyms}
The fast estimator averages all observations.
The rapid estimator averages only observations that pass the quality filter.
The two names sound similar, but this text does not assert that they denote the same estimator.

\section{Missing context}
The stability assumption is stated in the omitted companion manuscript.
Consequently the preceding theorem applies under its assumptions.
